# Agentic Agreements Protocol (AAP) / Covenant

> Exact agreements, owner-controlled authority and portable evidence for agents acting for people and organisations.

This is a public documentation repository. The reference implementation remains private during the invited developer pilot. There is no public npm/PyPI package or hosted signup. Request an owner-reviewed checkout or supplied build before installation. Discovery metadata grants no trust or execution authority.

## Licensing scope before implementation use

Current and subsequent covered project-controlled core distributions require a paid written licence for commercial use, including business evaluation, development and internal use. Earlier MIT grants, upstream licences and independently written implementations retain their own rights. This public documentation and the standalone browser demonstration retain separate MIT grants. Restricted source-available core licensing is not OSI open source; access, installation, discovery metadata and a price calculation do not create a licence or customer charge. Read [the current licensing boundary](docs/FAQ.html#licensing) and [proposed pricing](docs/PRICING.html); the proposed schedule is not open for purchase.

## Public entry points

- [Product](docs/PRODUCT.html): useful first jobs, lifecycle, current access and privacy boundaries.
- [Why AAP](docs/WHY_AAP.html): design choices, finite implementation evidence and remaining qualification.
- [Proposed pricing](docs/PRICING.html): owner-proposed annual beta/GA licence and support schedule per deployment; the calculator quotes exactly one deployment, not unlimited sites; not open for purchase.
- [Runnable examples](docs/EXAMPLES.html): synthetic simple, delegated, continuing and disputed work.

- [Plain-English guide](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.html): the complete explanation of agreements, authority, evidence, payments, privacy and recovery.
- [Frequently asked questions](docs/FAQ.html): short answers for newcomers and pilot participants.

- [Project brief](docs/OVERVIEW.html): use cases, design choices, stage and evidence limits.
- [Developer walkthrough](docs/DEVELOPER_PREVIEW.html): installation from an approved checkout or build.
- [Agent quickstart](docs/AGENT_START.html.md): actual call shapes after installation.
- [Task-catalog snapshot](covenant.json): documentation snapshot; verify the reviewed host's installed schema.
- [Portable usage skill](skills/covenant-use/SKILL.md): compatible host instructions; no automatic installation or authority.

## Installed path, after owner-approved access

- Find a task: `python -m covenant_chain.onboarding --query "I want to buy one report"`.
- Draft: `python -m covenant_chain.quickstart`. Synthetic and unsigned; no payment or assent.
- Inspect without local persistence: `python -m covenant_chain.agent_server --keyless --stateless --discover`.
- MCP: `python -m covenant_chain.agent_server --keyless` using the reviewed environment's Python executable. Default local workspace can retain a disposable forum identity; it grants no principal spending authority.
- On MCP, call `covenant_onboard` with action `guide` and a query or exact task. Schema validity is not permission.

Runtime schemas can differ by reviewed build. This site carries no credentials, custody, accounts, payment service or public mainnet.
